plain: You need to pay us within 30 days of getting the invoice.
legal: The Client shall pay each invoice in full within thirty (30) days of the date of receipt thereof.

plain: If you pay late, we'll add 1.5% interest every month.
legal: Any amount not paid when due shall accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month until paid in full.

plain: The total price for the project is $12,000.
legal: The total consideration payable for the Project shall be $12,000.

plain: Half the money is due up front and the rest when we finish.
legal: Fifty percent (50%) of the fees shall be payable in advance, and the remaining balance shall become due upon completion of the Services.

plain: We won't start work until we get the deposit.
legal: The Provider shall not be obligated to commence performance of the Services until receipt of the deposit.

plain: All prices include tax.
legal: All prices stated herein are inclusive of applicable taxes.

plain: You pay for any bank fees when you send us money.
legal: The Client shall bear all bank charges and transfer fees incurred in connection with any payment made hereunder.

plain: If you think an invoice is wrong, tell us within 10 days.
legal: The Client shall notify the Provider in writing of any disputed invoice within ten (10) days of receipt thereof.

plain: You still have to pay the parts of the invoice you don't disagree with.
legal: The Client shall pay any undisputed portion of an invoice in accordance with its terms, notwithstanding any dispute concerning the remainder.

plain: We can stop working if you haven't paid for 45 days.
legal: The Provider may suspend performance of the Services if any amount remains unpaid for a period of forty-five (45) days after its due date.

plain: Payment should be made by bank transfer to the account on the invoice.
legal: All payments shall be made by bank transfer to the account designated on the relevant invoice.

plain: The monthly fee is $800 and it's charged on the first of each month.
legal: A monthly fee of $800 shall be charged on the first (1st) day of each calendar month.

plain: Prices might go up once a year, but by no more than 5%.
legal: The Provider may increase the fees once in any twelve (12) month period, provided that no such increase shall exceed 5%.

plain: We'll give you 60 days' notice before raising prices.
legal: The Provider shall give the Client not less than sixty (60) days' prior written notice of any fee increase.

plain: You can't hold back payment because you think we owe you something.
legal: The Client shall not withhold or set off any amount payable hereunder against any sum claimed to be owed by the Provider.

plain: Travel expenses get paid back only if you approved them first.
legal: Travel expenses shall be reimbursed only where the Client has approved such expenses in writing prior to their being incurred.

plain: Send receipts for any expenses you want paid back.
legal: Any request for reimbursement of expenses shall be accompanied by the corresponding receipts.

plain: We'll refund the deposit if we cancel the job.
legal: In the event that the Provider cancels the engagement, the Provider shall refund the deposit to the Client in full.

plain: The deposit is not refundable if you cancel.
legal: The deposit shall be non-refundable in the event of cancellation by the Client.

plain: You'll get an invoice at the end of each month for the hours we worked.
legal: The Provider shall invoice the Client at the end of each calendar month for the hours worked during that month.

plain: Our rate is $95 an hour.
legal: The Services shall be charged at an hourly rate of $95.

plain: Any work over 40 hours a week is billed at one and a half times the normal rate.
legal: Any hours worked in excess of forty (40) hours in a single week shall be billed at one and one-half (1.5) times the standard hourly rate.

plain: Payments are in US dollars unless we agree otherwise.
legal: Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Parties, all payments shall be made in US dollars.

plain: If you pay the whole year up front, you get 10% off.
legal: Where the Client pays the annual fee in full in advance, the Client shall be entitled to a discount of 10%.

plain: You must pay even if you don't end up using the service.
legal: The Client's payment obligations shall apply irrespective of whether the Client makes use of the Service.

plain: We can charge your card automatically every month.
legal: The Client hereby authorizes the Provider to charge the Client's payment card automatically on a monthly basis.

plain: If the card payment fails, we'll try again after 3 days.
legal: In the event that a card payment is declined, the Provider may re-attempt the charge after three (3) days.

plain: Late fees are capped at $200 per invoice.
legal: The aggregate late fees applicable to any single invoice shall not exceed $200.

plain: Payment is due on receipt.
legal: Payment shall be due immediately upon receipt of the invoice.

plain: The buyer pays the shipping costs.
legal: All shipping costs shall be borne by the Buyer.

plain: We'll pay you within 15 business days after you deliver the goods.
legal: The Buyer shall make payment within fifteen (15) business days following delivery of the Goods.

plain: You agree to pay our legal costs if we have to chase you for money.
legal: The Client shall reimburse the Provider for all reasonable legal costs incurred in recovering any overdue amount.

plain: Invoices should be sent to accounts@brightpath.io.
legal: All invoices shall be addressed to accounts@brightpath.io.

plain: The final payment of $3,500 is due on March 31, 2027.
legal: The final installment of $3,500 shall be due and payable on March 31, 2027.

plain: We may ask for a security deposit of up to two months' fees.
legal: The Provider may require the Client to provide a security deposit in an amount not exceeding two (2) months' fees.

plain: You're only charged for the users who are active that month.
legal: The Client shall be charged solely in respect of users who are active during the relevant month.

plain: Don't pay in cash.
legal: Payment shall not be made in cash.

plain: Each milestone payment is due once the client signs off on that milestone.
legal: Each milestone payment shall become due upon the Client's written acceptance of the corresponding milestone.

plain: If we overcharge you, we'll credit the difference on your next bill.
legal: Any amount overcharged shall be credited to the Client's account and applied against the next invoice.

plain: Refunds will be made to the original payment method within 14 days.
legal: Any refund shall be issued to the original method of payment within fourteen (14) days.

plain: The fee covers up to 20 hours of support a month; extra hours cost $60 each.
legal: The fee shall cover up to twenty (20) hours of support per month, and each additional hour shall be charged at $60.

plain: Unused hours don't roll over to the next month.
legal: Unused hours shall not be carried forward to any subsequent month.

plain: The tenant has to pay rent by the 5th of every month.
legal: The Tenant shall pay the rent on or before the fifth (5th) day of each month.

plain: Commission is 8% of the sale price and is paid when the sale closes.
legal: A commission of 8% of the sale price shall be payable upon completion of the sale.

plain: You can pay in 4 equal monthly installments.
legal: The Purchaser may pay the purchase price in four (4) equal monthly installments.

plain: If you miss one installment, the whole remaining balance becomes due right away.
legal: In the event that the Purchaser fails to pay any installment when due, the entire outstanding balance shall become immediately due and payable.

plain: We'll send you a reminder 7 days before each payment is due.
legal: The Provider shall send the Client a reminder not less than seven (7) days before each payment due date.

plain: Only the person named on the account can ask for a refund.
legal: Only the named account holder shall be entitled to request a refund.

plain: Taxes are your responsibility, except tax on our income.
legal: The Client shall be responsible for all applicable taxes, excluding any taxes levied on the Provider's income.

plain: Payment by cheque is only accepted for amounts under $1,000.
legal: Payment by cheque shall be accepted only in respect of amounts below $1,000.
